'''Khypes''' was a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Codex" /> Around [[3645 BBY]],<ref name="Voss-Date" /> Khypes was sent to the recently-discovered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Voss]] with a [[Khypes's battle cruiser|battle cruiser]] and several [[Army/Legends|army]] [[Division/Legends|divisions]] to conquer the world and its powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Voss (species)|natives]]. Khypes arrived in the [[Voss system/Legends|Voss system]], but before the general could contact the Voss, Khypes's [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruiser]]<ref name="Codex" /> was overridden by the technology of the secretive [[Star Cabal]]<ref name="Hidden Throne">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Hidden Throne|Isen Four}} establishes that [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] investigates all occurrences of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] spontaneously exploding via [[Hunter (Star Cabal)|Hunter's]] override technology in the last five [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and this leads [[Cipher Nine]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and [[Voss]]. Additionally, the [[Star Cabal]] sends the [[Albathius|Shining Man]] to Voss in the aftermath of the [[Invasion of Voss|invasion]], as they wish to prevent the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from controlling the world. Thus, it can be determined that the Voss invasion was also caused by the Star Cabal.</ref> and exploded, and the escort [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were destroyed only moments later. Khypes's [[Death/Legends|death]] and the loss of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] astonished both the Empire and the Republic, who were unable to find the cause of the explosion, and the Empire declared Khypes to have been a rogue officer as they made diplomatic overtures to the Voss.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Khypes was first mentioned in the Codex entry "The Imperial Attack on Voss" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
